name: comp-127
title: Directional Pan Controls
blurb: D-pad style directional buttons for panning camera in four directions.
description: A 3x3 grid of directional buttons with chevron icons for up, left, right, and down. Center shows a circle indicator. Used for navigation in 3D or map interfaces.
use_when: Providing intuitive directional controls for camera or viewport panning.
avoid_when: When keyboard or mouse control is sufficient.
a11y: Each button has aria-label for direction. Center circle is aria-hidden.
